subject: English
stimulus: (a) Had I seen you before ⎯⎯. (b) He took up a part-time job so that ⎯⎯. (c) Corrupt persons are not only dishonest ⎯⎯. (d) Come forward to help them lest ⎯⎯. (e) I came here with a view to ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) Had I seen you before, I would have helped you. (b) He took up a part-time job so that he could live by himself. (c) Corrupt persons are not only dishonest but also dangerous. (d) Come forward to help them lest they should die. (e) I came here with a view to seeking help.
